New export classifyLiveSectionFetch({bookId,sectionId,atom,fetchError}) -- pure, 3-way classification (resolved / absent-verified / not-entitled / source-unavailable) plus the corrected atom?.data?.atom payload-extraction fix.

Forwards the already-read x-persona header to the upstream plan-review/icc backend (previously read only for the local smartFilesScopeRefusal check and then dropped).
New bastrop_tx/staff entry in the QA UI's PERSONAS list, plugging into G-114's existing ?cityKey= auto-select-by-orgId logic unchanged.

One existing test narrowed (IBC removed from the 'unchecked and absent-verified are not interchangeable' loop, with the reason recorded inline) + 9 new tests for the live path and classifyLiveSectionFetch's 4 outcomes.
New file, 8 tests for the persona + refusal function, same violation-tested shape as backend.test.mjs's G-106 suite.

threeQuestionGate_crossTenantRefusal.whatExecutes: engagementCrossTenantRefusal (actors.mjs), called from server.mjs's engMatch block on every request under /api/plan-review/engagements/:id/*.
threeQuestionGate_crossTenantRefusal.whatTriggers: Any GET or POST to that route subtree, on every request, regardless of whether a persona is asserted (the function itself decides pass-through vs refuse).
threeQuestionGate_crossTenantRefusal.whatFailsAndIsItLiveToday: A non-2xx (403 or 400) JSON response, returned before any sub-route logic runs. Live in production today: deployed to plan-review-00014-bbg (Cloud Run) and the plan-review-app Vercel production alias, both confirmed serving as of this checkpoint, both live-curled successfully post-deploy.
threeQuestionGate_crossTenantRefusal.whatBypasses: A caller that never sends x-persona reads unscoped -- named explicitly in the docstring and in CP1, not a gap discovered after the fact. A caller hitting the Cloud Run URL directly with a valid PLAN_REVIEW_SERVICE_TOKEN but crafting no x-persona header is in the same unscoped state as before this change for that one header; this is the stated 'narrowing not closure', identical in kind to G-106's own limitation.

threeQuestionGate_liveIbcPath.whatExecutes: classifyLiveSectionFetch (code-lookup.mjs), called from server.mjs's /api/plan-review/code route only when resolveCodeLookup returned live:true.
threeQuestionGate_liveIbcPath.whatTriggers: GET /api/plan-review/code?book=IBC2018P6&section=<digits-and-dots>, on every request for a section not in the static (empty) manifest.
threeQuestionGate_liveIbcPath.whatFailsAndIsItLiveToday: A typed-absence JSON body at the correct HTTP status (404/402/503 per kind), or a resolved 200 with a citation sourced from the fetched atom. Live in production today, same deploy as above; live-curled successfully for a real section (1001.1), a nonexistent one (9999.9), and an IRC-shaped one (R311.7).
threeQuestionGate_liveIbcPath.whatBypasses: IPMC2018P2 and BASTROP-UDC are untouched by design (no liveCodeEditionSlug), so nothing here changes their behaviour. A book added later without liveCodeEditionSlug gets no live path, silently -- named as a real limitation: this mechanism is opt-in per book, not automatic, and a future book with real content would need the same field added deliberately.

meaningShapedNotPresenceShaped: classifyLiveSectionFetch's three failure branches each key off an INDEPENDENTLY DERIVED signal from the substrate's own response shape (a confirmed {atom:null}, a specific accessPolicy-denial string, or neither), not a single presence/absence check on one field. A caller could not satisfy 'resolved' by returning any truthy object; it must carry title, bodyText, or sectionNumber specifically, and the confirmed-absent branch requires the EXACT nested-null shape the substrate emits, not merely 'no title'.
howThisCouldStillGoWrong: The NOT_ENTITLED string match is against the substrate's own live-verified wording today. If hauska-mcp-server's accessPolicy-denial message ever changes, this degrades to the generic SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE bucket -- never to a false 200, but the absence gets less specific silently. Named here rather than left to be rediscovered.

engagementCrossTenantRefusal only fires when x-persona is present. The QA UI (web/app.js) sends it on every request once a persona is chosen, but a caller integrating directly against the Cloud Run API (not through this UI) must know to send it -- there is no separate documentation surfacing that requirement beyond this code and its comments.

The substrate accessPolicy-rollup-vs-per-atom-enforcement disagreement found during investigation (CP1) is unresolved and not owned by this repo. If the substrate's per-atom accessPolicy loosens to match its jurisdiction-rollup 'public-free' claim, callers without a key would suddenly succeed where they previously got NOT_ENTITLED -- watched, not fixed, here.
